title: PanKbase: A Centralized Knowledge Base of the Human Pancreas for Diabetes Research
bodyHtml:
The HIRN Webinar “PanKbase: A Centralized Knowledge Base of the Human Pancreas for Diabetes Research" was held on Tuesday, August 12th.  

The webinar is accessible on YouTube at: https://youtu.be/3qLiBdIOJhY

Please follow us on LinkedIn or Twitter for updates on HIRN including future webinars!

From the: Human Islet Research Enhancement Center (HIREC) at City of Hope
summary: The HIRN Webinar held on Tuesday, August 12th recording is now available on YouTube.
